birthdayMessage: It is your birthday again! This time I use AI help to make your birthday extra special. I couldn't decide what present to give you this year... So I decided to let you choose. I love you so much and I hope you have a wonderful birthday! 💖

cards.title: A Romantic Buffet Date
cards.description: A special date at Manila Peninsula Buffet to celebrate your birthday. ❤️

cards.title: A Gift You Choose
cards.description: You get to pick one item you've been wanting. This one is entirely up to you. 😊

cards.title: Shopping Spree 10k
cards.description: Let us buy whatever you want and need! Clothes, accessories, or anything else you have your heart set on. 🥰
